aws.evidence: Public IPv4 Linux 4GB $24; 8GB $44. Object storage 5/100/250GB $1/$3/$5. Regular on-demand rates, no free trial credited.
aws.eligibility: Account and chosen region required. Mumbai transfer quota is half published headline allowance. No load/traffic benchmark on these SKUs. Local training compute must exist or be separately costed.

aws_tax.evidence: India GST listed at 18%. No input-tax credit assumed.
aws_tax.eligibility: Check entity / invoice at purchase. This is not a tax opinion for household contributions.

airtel.evidence: Regular 499 plan, up to 40 Mbps; no promotion or OTT plan counted.
airtel.eligibility: Address feasibility and permitted community use not confirmed. One community connection, NOT connectivity to 100 separate sites. No free installation credited.

telecom_tax.evidence: 18% telecom GST; supplier also states GST additional.
telecom_tax.eligibility: Tax-inclusive cash cost. No input-tax credit assumed.

task_estimate.evidence: Explicit engineering task estimates, not observed times, wage surveys, legal minimum wages or supplier quotes.
task_estimate.eligibility: Negotiate paid incremental hours; do not assume existing staff work for free. Contractor 18% tax is a planning allowance, not established tax applicability.

quote_needed.evidence: No installed quote, agreement, meter inventory or measured dispatch available.
quote_needed.eligibility: Required to close total economics; null does not mean zero.

items.name: cloud_compute
items.explanation: 4GB low/base; 8GB high. Hosting / aggregation allowance, not proven 100-client distributed compute.

items.name: offsite_storage
items.explanation: Separate archive/export allowance; no egress overage included within assumed quota.

items.name: community_connectivity
items.explanation: Charge full added line, rather than silently assume an existing line is free.

items.name: operator_review
items.explanation: 15/30/60 min each day x 30 days. Direct paid operator allowance; rate includes employment overhead by assumption. No round-the-clock SLA.

items.name: software_support
items.explanation: Patch, backup check and model/application issue review. Paid contractor allowance, no development profit or 24h support.

items.name: data_health_maintenance
items.explanation: Readout, timestamp and mapping checks only. Different tasks from software support. Physical asset maintenance remains separate.

items.name: onboarding_integration
items.explanation: Existing data export mapping, configuration and acceptance checks; not new electrical installation or 100 edge computers.

items.name: operator_training
items.explanation: Paid operator training hours. Technical trainer time is included in onboarding, not charged again.

items.name: connectivity_commissioning_allowance
items.explanation: Budget allowance for site visit/connection commissioning, not provider quote. No promotional installation waiver counted.

items.name: incremental_meter_gateway_retrofit
items.explanation: Meter/gateway inventory, local compute, safety installation and API access unknown. Add installed quote or explicitly confirm reusable capability; no default zero.

items.name: incremental_asset_access
items.explanation: Additional reserve availability/access charge, above already-paid existing owner contract. Unknown, not free.

items.name: existing_asset_maintenance
items.payer: existing asset owner, existing funding unchanged unless agreement varies
items.explanation: Do not charge original equipment capex again. Existing O&M still belongs in total operating cost.

items.name: existing_asset_access
items.explanation: Current asset availability fee. Separate from incremental_asset_access, no duplicate base fee.

items.name: consumed_backup_energy
items.explanation: Actual consumed backup x delivered-energy unit cost. Quantity after GridMesh may change, but scheduled backup is NOT consumption. GridMesh-induced consumption change remains unknown.

items.name: new_backup_equipment
items.explanation: Installed backup equipment quote with life and residual value. No replacement of existing owner equipment in existing-assets scenario.

items.name: new_backup_financing
items.explanation: Quoted repayment including principal/interest. Alternative to equipment straight-line recovery; never automatically add both.

funding.explanation: No sponsor, subsidy, DISCOM payment or free labour assumed. Conditional funding requires an explicitly named payer.
